description: Source code for a disk cache memory test utility, including functions for cache backend creation, memory parsing, and command-line interface handling.

classes.name: CacheSpec
classes.description: Represents cache configuration specifications, including parsing from string.

methods.name: CacheSpec::Parse
methods.description: Parses a cache specification string into a CacheSpec object.

methods.name: SetSuccessCodeOnCompletion
methods.description: Sets success flag based on net error and quits run loop.

methods.name: CreateAndInitBackend
methods.description: Creates and initializes a cache backend based on CacheSpec.

methods.name: ParseRangeLine
methods.description: Parses a memory range line from /proc/<PID>/smaps.

methods.name: ParseRangeProperty
methods.description: Parses memory range property lines from /proc/<PID>/smaps.

methods.name: GetMemoryConsumption
methods.description: Calculates total private dirty memory from /proc/<PID>/smaps.

methods.name: CacheMemTest
methods.description: Performs memory test on specified cache backends.

methods.name: PrintUsage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the utility.

methods.name: ParseAndStoreSpec
methods.description: Parses cache spec string and stores it in vector.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Main function handling command-line arguments and executing cache memory test.
